purpose: Generate compact art-derived causal overlay component sources. These are not faces: at runtime they compose over the locked V9 daily face, whose eyes/highlights, brows and mouth retain the primary emotional performance.

locked_reference.use: the sole visual reference for line weight, black-and-white treatment, rounded geometry and restrained character grammar

recording_input.semantic: quiet incoming sound is captured from the environment toward the character

wireless_charging.semantic: SUPERSEDED_BY_COMP_REQ_189: the source omitted the owner-confirmed bottom-attached charging connector

composition_contract: A native 200x200 preview composes every candidate only over the locked V9 daily baseline; no generated full face is accepted.
Daily eye/highlight, brow and mouth micro-choreography remains visible during event overlays and must not be obscured by an overlay.
Each event has deterministic entry, hold and release component frames; no random selection and no full-frame/card rotation.
Question mark, exclamation mark, cloud and sparkle remain separately registered emotion-decoration components, not implicit text or code-drawn substitutes.
source_gate: The generated source contains no face, body, text, label, border, UI panel, cable, battery icon or detached dashboard widget.
At native 200x200 composition, required overlay ink remains at least 8 pixels from the canvas edge and does not cover daily eye, brow or mouth masks.
The three frames communicate the specified causal direction with labels hidden.
A rejected source is frozen audit-only and cannot be a visual reference, exported component, runtime binding or firmware asset.
